method: Unchanged official virtual controller page and Python SDK through the observation proxy into the production Java WifiControllerServer on desktop JVM. Real Chromium game frames with synthetic Android bridge; no model or clock writes.
rotationPreconditionNote: The random initial piece was T; the new conditional O-soft-drop branch was not needed in this run.
heldSyncEvidence: Matched original SDK held-B sync ACK, then a subsequent ordinary RIGHT frame on the second seat. Its B action stayed false and gameplay stayed paused; first seat resumed on fresh START.
disconnectEvidence: After ordinary held RIGHT/A and SDK disconnect, the game paused and its actual player/model snapshot stayed equal through the freeze interval and reconnect sync. Only fresh START resumed.
proxyReview: The final observer sends FIN when the SDK disconnects and continues recording remaining server ACKs. It forwards no fabricated input, drops no input records, and writes replies to the SDK only while that downstream remains writable. Abrupt disconnect still causes normal server EOF and game pause.

visualReview.findings: Both menu sizes and gameplay/pause/reconnect screenshots are readable with complete action controls. Actual rotation and pause overlay are visible. Static discovery text and unavailable QR placeholder belong to the synthetic browser bridge, not an Android-device connectivity result.
